title: Topological Sort
signature: def topological_sort(num_nodes: int, edges: list[list[int]]) -> list[int] | None:
docstring: Given a directed graph with nodes 0..num_nodes-1 and directed edges [u, v] meaning u must come before v, return any valid topological order. If a cycle exists, return None (or empty list is not used; reference returns None).
